svg: Chemical diagrams generated only from encoded SMILES with RDKit; source PDF figures and crops are excluded.
verified_parent_structures: Paclitaxel and doxycycline use the exact isomeric SMILES in examples/verified-structures.json; immutable source attribution and locally computed identity/stereochemistry checks are recorded separately there. Doxycycline is indexed as neutral parent, not its paper-reported hydrochloride isolate.
